verdict: Unresolved planet-like signal, not statistically validated: TRICERATOPS gives FPP 0.05125 ± 0.00162 and NFPP 0, but the joint pixel vet does not establish an on-target origin and per-sector depths are inconsistent. The sector-97 anomaly dominates the localisation; this is not a secure identification of a neighbouring eclipsing binary.
molusc_note: No MOLUSC/Gaia-limits variant was run for the 24.1 d reference; matched that configuration.
